race.comment: I'M A HOTTIE (9) has stepped up sharply in grade since a win in BM56 company three back. Went to the lead a long way from home before tiring out of contention over 1350m at Strathalbyn last start. Comes back in class today so watch for a far better performance. HARMONIC DANCER (8) made it four minor placings from as many runs this prep when he made late ground to get up for third last time out over 1400m at this track. Blinkers going back on today might be what he needs to return to winning ways. KORATORA (11) bolted in two runs back at BM56 level then struggled in a BM70 last Saturday over 1200m on the main track here. Worth another chance in this more suitable company. MORE THAN HOPE (2) hasn't landed a blow in two runs this prep. Fitter now and getting out to a preferable journey will help the cause. MURPH (3) is slowly finding form - just needs luck from a wide alley to be very competitive.
